subject: Materials Science
title: PET: From Bottles to Clothing
description: A 60-second lesson on PET: From Bottles to Clothing.

hook.text: Your water bottle and your fleece jacket may be the exact same plastic — PET.

buildup.text: PET is a polyester — strong, clear, and an excellent barrier against gases.

discovery.text: Blow-molding stretches PET into thin-walled bottles that hold carbonation for months.

twist.text: Recycled PET bottles are shredded into flakes and spun into polyester fiber for clothing.

climax.text: PET is the most recycled plastic in the world — bottle to shirt in a closed loop.

punchline.text: Drink from it, then wear it. PET lives twice.

quiz.question: What makes PET ideal for beverage bottles?
options: It blocks gases well and is transparent
It is the softest plastic available
